name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana (Uttar Pradesh)
benefit: ₹25,000 in six stages - at birth, after vaccination, and on admission to Class 1, 6, 9 and to graduation or diploma.
summary: Staged cash support for daughters of UP families earning up to ₹3 lakh a year (at most two daughters per family).

name: UP Pre-Matric Scholarship (Class 9-10)
benefit: About ₹3,000 a year paid to the student's bank account.
summary: State scholarship for Class 9-10 students; family income up to ₹2.5 lakh for SC/ST and ₹2 lakh for general, OBC and minority students.

name: UP Post-Matric Scholarship and Fee Reimbursement
benefit: Maintenance allowance plus reimbursement of course fees.
summary: State scholarship from Class 11 onwards; family income up to ₹2.5 lakh for SC/ST and ₹2 lakh for general, OBC and minority students.

name: Mukhyamantri Krishak Durghatna Kalyan Yojana (Uttar Pradesh)
benefit: Up to ₹5 lakh to the family if a farmer dies or is disabled in an accident.
summary: Free accident cover for UP farmers, tenant farmers and their family members aged 18-70.
documents: FIR and post-mortem / disability certificate (when claiming)

name: UP Old Age Pension
benefit: ₹1,000 a month.
summary: Pension for UP residents aged 60+ with annual family income up to ₹46,080 (rural) or ₹56,460 (urban).

name: UP Nirashrit Mahila (Widow) Pension
benefit: ₹1,000 a month.
summary: Pension for widows aged 18+ in UP with annual family income up to ₹2 lakh.

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana (Bihar)
benefit: Support from birth to graduation, including ₹25,000 on passing Class 12 (unmarried) and ₹50,000 on graduating.
summary: Staged cash support for girls of Bihar (up to two daughters per family).

name: Bihar Student Credit Card
benefit: Education loan up to ₹4 lakh for higher studies at very low or zero interest.
summary: Loan for Bihar students up to age 25 who passed Class 12 and are joining higher education.

name: Mukhyamantri Vridhjan Pension Yojana (Bihar)
benefit: ₹1,100 a month (as revised in 2025).
summary: Universal old-age pension for Bihar residents aged 60+ who do not draw any government pension.

name: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
benefit: ₹1,250 to ₹1,500 a month paid into the woman's bank account.
summary: Monthly support for married, widowed or divorced women aged 21-60 in MP with family income up to ₹2.5 lakh.

name: Ladli Laxmi Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
benefit: About ₹1.43 lakh in total: scholarships at Class 6, 9, 11 and 12, college support and ₹1 lakh at age 21.
summary: Long-term support for daughters of MP families that do not pay income tax; the girl must be registered within a few years of birth.

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana (Maharashtra)
benefit: ₹1,500 a month paid into the woman's bank account.
summary: Monthly support for women aged 21-65 in Maharashtra with family income up to ₹2.5 lakh.

name: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi (Maharashtra)
benefit: An extra ₹6,000 a year from the state on top of PM-KISAN.
summary: Automatic top-up for Maharashtra farmers who receive PM-KISAN.

name: Kanyashree Prakalpa (West Bengal)
benefit: ₹1,000 a year for unmarried girls aged 13-18 in school, and a one-time ₹25,000 at age 18 if still studying and unmarried.
summary: Support to keep West Bengal girls in education and prevent early marriage.

name: Lakshmir Bhandar (West Bengal)
benefit: ₹1,000 a month (₹1,200 for SC/ST women).
summary: Monthly income support for women aged 25-60 in West Bengal.

name: Krishak Bandhu (West Bengal)
benefit: ₹4,000 to ₹10,000 a year depending on land size, plus ₹2 lakh to the family on the farmer's death (age 18-60).
summary: Income support and death benefit for West Bengal farmers and recorded sharecroppers.

name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai (Tamil Nadu)
benefit: ₹1,000 a month.
summary: Monthly support for women heads of family aged 21+ in Tamil Nadu with family income up to ₹2.5 lakh.

name: Pudhumai Penn (Tamil Nadu)
benefit: ₹1,000 a month until the course is finished.
summary: For girls who studied Class 6-12 in Tamil Nadu government schools and are now in college, diploma or ITI.

name: Rythu Bharosa (Telangana)
benefit: ₹12,000 per acre per year as crop investment support.
summary: Investment support for Telangana farmers with cultivable land.

name: Annadata Sukhibhava (Andhra Pradesh)
benefit: ₹20,000 a year in total, including the ₹6,000 from PM-KISAN.
summary: Income support for Andhra Pradesh farmer families, including tenant farmers.

name: Gruha Lakshmi (Karnataka)
benefit: ₹2,000 a month.
summary: Monthly support for the woman head of a Karnataka household, as named on the ration card.

name: Subhadra Yojana (Odisha)
benefit: ₹10,000 a year in two instalments, for five years.
summary: Support for Odisha women aged 21-60 with family income up to ₹2.5 lakh.

name: Namo Lakshmi Yojana (Gujarat)
benefit: ₹50,000 spread over Class 9 to 12.
summary: For girls studying in Class 9-12 in Gujarat with family income up to ₹6 lakh.

name: Mukhyamantri Maiyan Samman Yojana (Jharkhand)
benefit: ₹2,500 a month.
summary: Monthly support for Jharkhand women aged 18-50 from ration-card holding families.

name: Mahtari Vandan Yojana (Chhattisgarh)
benefit: ₹1,000 a month.
summary: Monthly support for married, widowed or divorced women aged 21+ in Chhattisgarh.

name: Orunodoi (Assam)
benefit: ₹1,250 a month paid to the woman of the household.
summary: Monthly support for women of Assam families earning under ₹2 lakh a year, with priority to widows and people with disabilities.
